coastal.title: New Westminster apartment building evacuated due to early morning fire
coastal.description: An emergency reception centre has been set up for displaced residents at the təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre located on East 6th Avenue.

kamloops.title: Okanagan growers say crop insurance isn’t keeping up with a changing climate
kamloops.description: The weather can bring extreme heat, cold, drought, hail or wildfire smoke, and any one of those can wipe out a crop or make grapes impossible to sell.

cariboo.title: Incumbent faces off against former mayor in Williams Lake election
cariboo.description: It will be a choice between two experienced candidates when Williams Lake voters go to the polls for the Oct. 17 municipal election.

southeast.title: How could wildfires affect Kimberley's drinking water? A $400K project aims to find out
southeast.description: Wildfires can change water quality and availability long after the flames are out. A new project in Kimberley, B.C., aims to better understand those risks.
